document.agentIntro: This repository implements the following project. BLUEPRINT.md contains the full requirements, TASKS.md the tasks. CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md contain the same rules.
rules: Read BLUEPRINT.md and TASKS.md first. Keep the agreed MVP scope and the non-goals.

Treat empty or vague sections, open decisions and AI suggestions that have not been accepted as unresolved. Ask targeted questions before affected implementation steps. Recommendations are not decisions.
Check the project roadmap against the proposed sequence in TASKS.md. The project roadmap takes precedence; agree on missing phases and acceptance criteria.
Use the defined tech stack and review existing code and working rules before making changes. Do not invent libraries, services or credentials that have not been decided.
Work in small, verifiable steps. Check the acceptance criteria of the current phase and report what was implemented and tested and what is still open.
Preserve existing user changes. Keep secrets and credentials out of source code, export files and commits.
Document new decisions and update tasks and the blueprint when changes have been agreed.
document.roadmapMissing: No project roadmap has been set yet. Clarify the order before implementing.
document.planNote: The following sequence is a template, not an agreed project plan. Reconcile it with the project roadmap. Derive concrete tasks and acceptance criteria from BLUEPRINT.md and clarify any missing details.

phases.title: Phase 0 – Clarify scope and open points
tasks: Clarify open points in BLUEPRINT.md with the user; record the necessary decisions.
Agree together on the MVP, non-goals, roadmap and acceptance criteria.
phases.acceptance: The requirements needed for the next step are clarified; remaining assumptions are visible.

phases.title: Phase 1 – Foundation and data model
tasks: Set up the project with the agreed tech stack; document how to start it and how to run the checks.
Prepare the agreed data model and the necessary integrations.
phases.acceptance: The project starts using the documented steps; the data model and integrations match BLUEPRINT.md.

phases.title: Phase 2 – MVP and user flows
tasks: Implement the core features within the agreed MVP scope.
Implement the user flows, including error cases, and verify them with suitable tests.
phases.acceptance: The core features and user flows described in BLUEPRINT.md work; non-goals have been respected.

phases.title: Phase 3 – Quality and handover
tasks: Review risks and open points; secure important error cases and data storage.
Document installation, use and operation; prepare the agreed release.
phases.acceptance: The agreed checks pass; usage and remaining limitations are documented.

document.startIntro: Implement the project “{{name}}” in this repository.
document.startBody: First read BLUEPRINT.md, CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, and TASKS.md in full. Briefly summarize the goal, MVP, non-goals and tech stack. Check the existing code and the open points. Clarify only the questions that block the next implementation step; do not treat vague content or AI suggestions as confirmed requirements. Reconcile the proposed sequence with the project roadmap. Then begin with the first clarified phase that is not yet completed, check its acceptance criteria and report the result. Do not invent missing requirements or credentials.
